v0.1.0.description:
This is the initial unstable release:

- Location checks for progress within levels ("checkpoints" / completions).
- 16 achievements can also be locations.
- Collect "Quadcopter Piece"s (placeholder name) to unlock a goal area.
- Unlock "abilities", for hole-based effects and items to catapult.
- A few levels can have special items/locations within them (Snake Danger, Salt & Pepper).
- Mostly functional UT support.
- A few fun traps / filler items.
- Some extra QOL features for dialog and achievements.
- And some yaml settings that can cause generation failure!

[See the repository](https://github.com/1e1001/DonutCountyAP/) for more information and setup instructions.
